answer.says: Ramesh, the haze is thick tonight, is it not? You have waited long enough for your wage. I will see to the electricity bill tomorrow morning, but tonight, I am too tired to cook. Will you bring me a simple dal and some rice? I will pay you for the trouble, and we can talk while you eat.
answer.thought: The brown haze presses against the window like a physical weight, mirroring the stagnation of my own file. Ramesh stands there, a figure of particular need against the universal silence of the house; I cannot ignore the ethical friction of my unpaid debt, yet I lack the strength to move. I will offer him a small kindness, a meal shared in the dark, to bridge the gap between my isolation and his service.
